groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: something done with the hands.

chars.story: A hand held flat underneath: it holds up the load.
chars.note: In 摩托 it only spells 'motor'. 託 had 讠 words; 托 has 扌 hand.

chars.story: A hand pushes the lean-to's wall outward: enlarge it.
chars.note: 擴 had a big 廣 on the right; now only 广.

chars.story: A hand working at something big until it is done.
chars.note: Loose spoken 'do, handle, make a mess of'.

chars.story: A hand takes in a whole scene and keeps it: capture it on camera.
chars.note: Means to take a photo or film: 拍摄 'shoot'. Also 'take in': 摄取.

chars.story: The hand lets go and the thing falls: drop.
chars.note: After a verb it means 'away, off': 吃掉 'eat up'.

chars.story: A hand with claws: grab hold.
A hand swings a banner as an army moves out: brandish.
chars.note: 揮 had 軍 army too; only 扌 was reshaped.

chars.story: A hand beckons people over: recruit them.
chars.note: Also 'beckon' and 'a move' in a fight.

chars.story: A hand reaches into a deep place to feel what is there: explore.
chars.note: Also 'visit' in 探望.

chars.story: A heart held in a tight grip: frightened.
chars.note: 恐怕 'I'm afraid that' is a polite 'probably'.

chars.story: A heart that does not let go of a thought: it harbors it.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'cherish'. 懷 had a long right side; 怀 puts 不 there.

chars.story: A heart pounding while the work piles up: urgent.
chars.note: Also 'hurry' and 'anxious'.

chars.parts: 虍 tiger top + 心 heart
chars.story: A heart pacing like a tiger, turning a problem over: consider.
chars.note: 慮 had 思 'think' in the middle; 虑 dropped it.

chars.story: A heart that feels something is off: strange.
chars.note: Also 'blame': 怪他 'blame him'.

chars.story: A clod of earth: a lump.
chars.note: Counts pieces and, in speech, yuan: 三块 'three yuan'. 塊 had 鬼; 块 uses 夬.

chars.story: The earth where you stop and stay: a site, an address.
Earth heaped around a young plant: cultivate it.
A grand hall on a raised earth floor.
chars.note: Also 'hall' for 课堂 'classroom'.

chars.parts: 人 person + 人 person + 土 earth
chars.story: Two people on the ground: sit.
chars.note: Also 'travel by': 坐车 'go by car'.

groups.title: walking 辶
groups.note: A road-and-foot sign on the left or below: movement.

chars.story: Walking after a pig, driving it on: pursue.
chars.note: Mostly met in 逐渐, 'bit by bit'.

chars.story: You walk out to meet a guest face to face: welcome.
Someone walks right up behind you and presses: compel.
Walking off the path set for you: violate it.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'go against'. 違 had 韋; 违 has 韦. Mostly rules and laws now.

chars.parts: - a trunk with branches above and roots below
chars.story: A tree: trunk, branches, roots.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'tree'. Modern use is mostly 'wood'.

chars.story: The tree whose fruit children grab: plum.
chars.note: Also the very common surname Li.

chars.story: Wood added to wood: a rack, a frame.
chars.note: Also counts planes: 一架飞机.

chars.story: A wooden strip levelling off a grain measure: roughly, in general.
The flesh at the front of the head: the face.
chars.note: 臉 had 僉; 脸 keeps only the shape 佥.

chars.story: Bare flesh once the clothes come off: take off.

chars.parts: - a cut of meat with fat lines in it
chars.story: A slab of meat with its marbling.
chars.note: As a part on the left it shrinks to 月.

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: A cap of grass on top: plants.

chars.story: Grass springing up in the early morning.
chars.note: Also 'rough' and 'draft': 草稿.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 右 right hand
chars.story: A right hand holding a plant could be anything: as if, supposing.
chars.note: A bookish 'if'. Also 'like, as': 若无其事.

chars.story: Old herbs chewed: bitter.
chars.note: Also 'hardship'.

groups.title: lean-to 广
groups.note: A roof leaning on one side: buildings and storage.

chars.story: A shed where carts are kept: a storehouse.
chars.note: 庫 had 車 cart; 车 is the simplified cart.

chars.story: Things given their places in a long shed: in sequence.
A big roof and a big feast: celebrate.
chars.note: 慶 had 心 and 鹿 inside; 庆 keeps 广 and 大.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A box on the left or below: speech, food, voice.

chars.story: A mouth open wide: call out, breathe out.
Something held inside the mouth: it contains within.
A scholar who speaks only good words: lucky.
chars.note: In 吉他 it only spells 'guitar'.

groups.title: roof 宀
groups.note: A roof on top: home and shelter.

chars.story: An altar set under a roof: the ancestors honored there.
chars.note: Also 'sect, school'.

chars.story: A hand keeping watch under the roof: keep watch.
chars.note: Also 'keep to': 守约 'keep a promise'.

chars.story: Settled under a roof with a nail in the wall: you would rather stay.
chars.note: Also 'peaceful'. 宁夏 Ningxia is a region. 寧 was far more elaborate.

chars.story: Fire turned violent: explode.
Flames running along a row: fierce.

chars.parts: 彐 cap shape + 火 fire
chars.story: A flame that moves of itself: spirit, quick.
chars.note: 靈 had rain and shamans; 灵 keeps a cap and 火.

chars.story: Water folded deep into the land: a cove.
chars.note: In modern prose it is mostly short for Macau and Australia.

chars.story: Water turned to air: vapor, steam.
chars.note: 汽车 'steam cart' is the ordinary word for car.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: Two strokes at the left: speech.

chars.story: Words that travel fast: news.
chars.note: 訊 had 訁 on the left; it became 讠.

chars.story: Words that you stand by: a promise.
chars.note: 諾: 訁 on the left became 讠.

groups.title: head 页
groups.note: A head with a body: the head and what it does.

chars.story: A head dropped suddenly, stopping short: pause.
chars.note: Counts meals and scoldings: 一顿饭 'a meal'. 頓: 頁 became 页.

chars.story: A head turned the way the river runs: go with it.
chars.note: 順: 頁 became 页. Reads as 'smooth' in 顺利.

chars.parts: 𡗗 shoots pushing up + 日 sun
chars.story: The sun warms the shoots pushing up: spring.
Young grain, a child of the harvest: a season.
chars.note: Also 'third, youngest': 季军 'third place'.

chars.story: A pole casts no shadow at midday: noon.

chars.parts: - a dot over a firm base
chars.story: Grain sifted until only the best is left: good.
chars.note: A bookish 'good'; used in compounds.

chars.parts: - a bar over a matched pair of hooks
chars.story: A pair of antlers side by side: matched and lovely.
chars.note: 麗 had a deer 鹿; 丽 kept only the antlers.

chars.story: A tall building lit up with a person standing under it: shine.
chars.note: Also 'light up'.

chars.parts: - a bar and cross shape, like fetters you slipped
chars.story: Slipping out of the fetters: fortunate.
chars.note: A surname too. Different from 辛 'bitter'.

chars.story: You run off and take it up because it grips you: interest.
A full store of grain and no hurry: steady.
chars.note: 穩 had 隱 on the right; 稳 uses 急.

chars.parts: - a box over a bar, then 贝 shell
chars.story: A high-priced thing set above the shell-money: expensive.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'high rank'. 貝 became 贝 at the bottom.

chars.story: A post left in the sun for days: worn.
chars.note: 舊 had a bird 隹. Used of things, not people: 老 is for people.

chars.parts: 耳 ear shape + 攵 tap
chars.story: Someone steps up and taps the beast: dare.
You stop and take the meat that is offered: agree to.
Strength spent hard: exert yourself, strive.
chars.note: Nearly always 努力.

chars.parts: 立 stand + 兄 elder brother
chars.story: Two brothers stand side by side, each trying to win: compete.
chars.note: Lookalike 竟. 競 had two 言 and two 儿.

groups.title: grammar words
groups.note: Little words that join a sentence.

chars.parts: - a man with two dots under his arms
chars.story: The two dots under the arms mark the other side too: also.
chars.note: Same word as in the Analects. In modern prose a formal 'also'.

chars.story: A piece of music played right to its end, and then to your surprise: unexpectedly.
chars.note: Lookalike 竞 'compete'.

chars.parts: ⺌ rising small + 冋 a roofed room
chars.story: Smoke still curling from a small house: still, yet.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'esteem'. Today mostly 'yet'; 时尚 keeps 'esteem'.

chars.story: The hand that brings food to the mouth: the right.
chars.note: Not 'right' as in correct: that is 对.

chars.story: What stands up at the very top: the tip.
chars.note: Also 'carry level in both hands': 端菜.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 付 hand over
chars.story: Something handed over and set against a mound: attached.

chars.parts: - a roof shape on a stem
chars.story: What stays on the plate after everyone has eaten: the remainder.
chars.note: 餘 had 饣 food on the left: leftover food.

chars.story: The animal that guards the door.

chars.parts: - a fish: head on top, body in a box, tail as a bar
chars.story: A fish stood on its tail.
chars.note: 魚's four tail dots became one bar.

chars.story: Fish and mutton, just killed: fresh.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'fresh'. In the Analects it also reads 'few'. 魚 became 鱼.

chars.story: A foot and a bundle: grab it and run.
The boat shape with a few mouths aboard: a ship.
The round part of a cart: the wheel.
chars.note: Also 'take turns'. 輪 had 車 and 侖.

chars.parts: - a collar, two sleeves and a hem
chars.story: A coat laid flat.
chars.note: Same as in the Analects. On the left it shrinks to 衤.

chars.story: Metal drawn out into one thin line: needle.
chars.note: 針 had 金 metal; it became 钅. Also 'injection': 打针.

chars.story: A hand peeling the outer layer off: skin, hide, leather.
chars.note: Means 'skin' in 皮肤 and 'peel' too.

chars.story: A long thing pulled over a big one: encase it, a case.
chars.note: Counts sets: 一套书.

chars.story: Pieces loaded onto one cart and set in order: edit.
chars.note: 輯: 車 became 车. In 逻辑 it only spells 'logic'.

chars.story: Threads gathered into one cloth: combine.
chars.note: 綜: 糸 became 纟.

chars.parts: - a frame holding two bending lines
chars.story: A line that winds up and down: a tune.
chars.note: Also 'bent, crooked'.

chars.parts: 無 nothing + 舛 two feet
chars.story: Two feet moving in empty space: dance.
People each in their proper place: the bonds between them.
chars.note: Mostly in 伦理 'ethics'.

chars.parts: 女 woman + 未 not yet
chars.story: A woman not yet grown: a younger sister.
A small one standing in the village: a child.
chars.note: Mostly in words for the young: 儿童 'children', 童年 'childhood'.

chars.story: A king in shining white, above all kings: emperor.
Food on the table: cooked rice, the meal.
chars.note: Also 'meal': 吃饭 'eat'. 飯: 食 became 饣.

chars.story: The eye droops: sleep.
Woods around an altar: no entry.
chars.note: Also 'endure': 禁不住.

chars.story: Someone springs onto a horse from nowhere to trick you: cheat.
chars.note: 騙: 馬 became 马.

chars.story: After rain the dew lies out on the road, in the open: reveal.
chars.note: Also 'dew' and 'outdoors': 露天.

chars.parts: - a stroke and a hand-shaped hook
chars.story: You come home, and your hand reaches for the door: go home.
chars.note: 歸 had 止 and 帚 broom; 归 keeps one stroke.

chars.story: A bird's wing flipping over: flip.
One hand over another, feeling around: search for it.
chars.note: 尋 had 工 and 口 inside.

chars.story: A dog led out as a gift: offer.
chars.note: 獻 had a big vessel 鬳; 献 uses 南.

sentences.en: She beckoned me to come in.
There's a dog close by barking.
I have an interest in photography.
I require a few clothes hangers.
Who runs faster, Ken or Tony?

sentences.zh: 我不想坐汽车去，宁可走去。
sentences.en: I don't want to go in the car. I would rather walk.

sentences.zh: 我睡午觉的时候做了个怪梦。
sentences.en: While napping, I had a strange dream.

sentences.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
sentences.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

sentences.zh: 抓饭肉是八块钱。素抓饭只是四块钱。
sentences.en: The pilaf with meat is eight yuan. The vegetarian pilaf is only four yuan.
